title: Assessment of therapeutic success after interstitial brachytherapy of hepatocellular carcinoma using the LI-RADS-TRA algorithm
summary: Bei der Studie handelt es sich um eine retrospektive Studie zur Korrelation LR-TRA mit Histopathologie, die an einem einzigen Zentrum durchgeführt wird.

interventions.name: The hospital's electronic database will be searched for all patients who received interstitial brachytherapy and subsequent transplantation. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
• HCC patients ≥18 years
• Z.n. Primary brachytherapy for HCC at the LMU Clinic with subsequent liver transplant 
• Presence of multiphasic MRI up to a maximum of 90 days before brachytherapy
• At least one multiphase MRI scan after brachytherapy up to a maximum of 90 days before transplantation
• No additional treatment of HCC before transplantation
Exclusion criteria:
• Incomplete imaging or insufficient imaging that interferes with correct image interpretation (e.g. due to artifacts).
